info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Economic Capital Management API
info.description: The Economic Capital Management API provides powerful tools for financial institutions to model, manage, and optimize their economic capital. This API enables users to submit economic capital models, facilitating effective risk assessment and regulatory compliance. Typical consumers include risk managers, financial analysts, and data scientists seeking to enhance their capital allocation strategies. By utilizing this API, organizations can make informed decisions about capital requirements and risk management, ultimately driving better financial performance.
